ABOUT AURUM STANDARD ANALYTICAL LABORATORIES

A deeper understanding of valuable materials.

Aurum Standard Analytical Laboratories is named for a discipline where careful observation, sound information and professional judgment matter.

OUR FOCUS

Different materials. Different questions.

Ore and mineral specimens call for attention to composition and sampling. Gold introduces fineness and representative measurement. Diamonds and gemstones involve questions of identity and characteristics. These material conversations also connect to processing, transport, buying and trading when the purpose requires it.

Good enquiry begins by distinguishing these needs rather than treating every specimen in the same way. Understanding the material and purpose helps define an examination that is relevant and an explanation that can be used responsibly.

Aurum Standard

OUR IDENTITY

A symbol of balance and purpose.

The ASL emblem brings the image of a balance scale together with a diamond: a visual expression of considered measurement and the value of understanding a material before drawing a conclusion.

The company name and service line are brought forward with care, presenting a clear identity for minerals, gold, diamonds and gemstones.

A DISCIPLINED APPROACH

The value of a clear process.

Information becomes useful when the specimen is identifiable, the purpose of the assessment is understood, and the resulting information is communicated in context.

From initial description through evaluation and reporting, an organised process helps the reader understand what was assessed and which conclusions belong to that sample.

How the process works ↗
OUR PRINCIPLES

A considered approach from first question to final interpretation.

01

Precision of purpose

Start with the right question, not only a standard list of measurements.

02

Respect for the specimen

Maintain consistent identification and an appropriate handling approach.

03

Clarity of communication

Explain technical information so it can be interpreted responsibly.

THE NEXT STEP

Begin with the right question.

A concise material description and your intended outcome are a useful starting point.
